name: A Blip Through Reality 2: Hot and Hunky!
source:
Both Bella and her imaginary friend Blip have grown up and have learnt to love! Throughout many random encounters including Deer from Dear Evan Handsome, Jesus from The Bible, Alejandro Sigma Samuel Burr and many other fan favourites. And of course, at centre stage is Blip, who in recent years has become quite the musclehead. Dive deep into Bella's new, and slightly upgraded, dreams as you interact with the most handsome hotties from your favourite franchises, as well as historical hits such as Cheerleader Hillary Clinton! Do your best to please all your potential partners, and hopefully you can steal their hearts! Both metaphorically, AND, in some cases, literally! It's time to try defying gravity in this high stakes, high action, heart pounding, heart throbbing, and most importantly HOT, HOT, HOT, tale of delusional love and adventure in this long awaited sequel to A Blip Through Reality!
